identity.name: horMoscope Ai
identity.core_concept: Your body is a universe. Track its phases.

brand.usage: Logo, Personal Greetings (e.g., 'Good morning, Goddess'), Signature touches

headings.usage: Page Titles, Section Headers, Card Titles
headings.characteristics: Elegant, High-contrast, Uppercase for small labels

body.weights: Light (300) for body, Medium (500) for buttons

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E8D5B5] to-[#D4C1A1] text-[#12090E] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium tracking-widest uppercase text-xs hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(232,213,181,0.3)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[#E8D5B5] rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-light tracking-widest uppercase text-xs hover:bg-white/10 transition-all

cards.glass: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-[32px] p-6 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)]

inputs.style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-[#FDF8FA] placeholder:text-white/20 focus:border-[#E8D5B5] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E8D5B5] outline-none transition-all

layout.spacing: Generous padding (p-6, p-8). Never cram content.
layout.radius: rounded-3xl or rounded-full. No sharp edges.

motion.orb_animation: pulse-glow 4s infinite alternate, float 6s infinite ease-in-out

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user HATES the 'office-like' look. Do not use standard Shadcn cards. Use the 'glass' classes defined above.
THE ORB: The Home Page must feature a large, central, pulsating orb (CSS or Image) that represents the cycle day. It should 'breathe'.
FONTS: Use 'Italiana' for ALL headings. Use 'Sacramento' for the App Name and personal greetings (e.g., 'Hello, Goddess').
COLORS: Implement the 'Phases' color system. The entire app theme (glows, borders, orb color) should shift based on the selected cycle phase.
NAVIGATION: Use a floating glass bottom bar, not a standard fixed tab bar.
IMAGES: Use the provided texture images as subtle overlays (opacity 10-20%) on backgrounds to add depth.
TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
